content.title: All Marvel Rivals Season 7 Battle Pass skins: The Tablet of Life and Time!
content.text: New York City is in chaos due to the Tablet of Life and Time. Here's what players can expect from the Marvel Rivals Season 7 Battle Pass. Marvel Rivals Season 7 arrives on March 20 with a slew of new content such as three new stories, White Fox as a playable hero, a basketball mini-game, plus the Dual Life of Peter Parker event. The patch also arrives with a new rewards track! Read on for a closer look at all of the Marvel Rivals Season 7 Battle Pass skins. Marvel Rivals Season 7 Battle Pass The Marvel Rivals Season 7 Battle Pass, also known as The Tablet of Life and Time, becomes available on March 20. It includes 10 new costumes such as Helen Angerboda: The Rebel Hela, Badlands Lullaby Peni Parker, and Park Sun-young: The Dancer Luna Snow. Players can also unlock exclusive cosmetics as they progress through the track. Below is the official Marvel Rivals Season 7 Battle Pass trailer. It’s centered around the chaos in New York City caused by the Tablet of Life and Time. Characters are fighting for control over it. The trailer gives players a preview of the aforementioned costumes plus ones like Low-Key Loki and Thor, Doom Angel Angela, Living Tribunal Adam Warlock, Ardent Archer Hawkeye as well. All Marvel Rivals Season 7 Battle Pass skins Ardent Archer – Hawkeye costume Badlands Lullaby – Peni Parker costume Doom Angel – Angela costume Helen Angerboda: The Rebel – Hela costume Living Tribunal – Adam Warlock costume Low-Key – Loki costume Low-Key – Thor costume Park Sun-young: The Dancer – Luna Snow costume Rocky: The Transfer – Rocket Raccoon costume Stephen Sanders: The Doctor – Doctor Strange costume Ardent Archer – Hawkeye Ardent Archer Hawkeye Badlands Lullaby – Peni Parker Badlands Lullaby Peni Parker (Image via NetEase Games) Doom Angel – Angela Doom Angel Angela (Image via NetEase Games) Helen Angerboda: The Rebel – Hela Helen Angerboda: The Rebel Hela (Image via NetEase Games) Living Tribunal – Adam Warlock The Living Tribunal Adam Warlock costume in the Marvel Rivals Season 7 Battle Pass (Image via NetEase Games) Low-Key – Loki Low-Key Loki (Image via NetEase Games) Low-Key – Thor Low-Key Thor (Image via NetEase Games) Park Sun-young: The Dancer – Luna Snow Park Sun-young: The Dancer Luna Snow Rocky: The Transfer – Rocket Raccoon Rocky: The Transfer Rocket Raccoon (Image via NetEase Games) Stephen Sanders: The Doctor – Doctor Strange The Stephen Sanders: The Doctor skin (Image via NetEase Games) According to NetEase Games, this Battle Pass does not expire. That is, once it’s purchased, it can be completed at one’s own pace. That’s all for now. Are you excited about Marvel Rivals Season 7? Stick around on esports.gg for more news and updates.
